1.projectName: Expansion Project 1320 (2x660) MW Super Critical Coal Based Thermal Power Plant

concerns.title: Public hearing exempted
concerns.explanation: Public hearing was exempted despite the project being in a populated area with schools and health centers nearby. This denies residents a chance to voice concerns about pollution and impacts.
concerns.quote: Public hearing for the 2x660 MW (Phase - II) is exempted as per S.O. 1247(E) dated 18.03.3021.

concerns.title: Existing non-compliance
concerns.explanation: The previous 600 MW unit operated without proper name transfer of statutory documents, violating environmental laws. This raises concerns about the company's compliance history.
concerns.quote: Though the EC has been transferred from M/s Lanco Amarkantak Power Pvt. Ltd. to M/s Korba Power Ltd., other mandatory statutory documents (CTO, Hazardous Wastes Authorization, PLI Policy etc.) are still in the name of M/s Lanco Amarkantak Power Pvt. Ltd.

concerns.title: Air quality impacts
concerns.explanation: The plant will emit pollutants like PM2.5, SO2, and NOx. While control technologies are proposed, past compliance issues and the plant's location near residential areas raise concerns about air quality impacts on health.
concerns.quote: AAQ parameters at PM2.5: 52 μg/m3 – 20.5 μg/m3 PM10: 68.1 μg/m3 – 28.1 μg/m3 SO2: 19.6 μg/m3 – 1.5 μg/m3 NOx: 19.2 μg/m3 – 2.1 μg/m3

concerns.title: Water usage from Hasdeo River
concerns.explanation: The plant will draw 104,110 m³/day from the Hasdeo River, which flows nearby. This could affect water availability for local communities and ecosystems, especially during dry seasons.
concerns.quote: Water requirement for the proposed project is estimated as 104110 m3 /day, out of which 104110 m3/day of freshwater requirement which will be meet from the Hasdeo River.

concerns.title: Ash disposal and utilization
concerns.explanation: The plant will generate ash at 4060 TPD. While utilization plans exist, past utilization rates were below mandate, and the proposed ash pond may require careful management to prevent contamination.
concerns.quote: Ash generation will be limited to 4060 T PD. Ash generated should be used in phased manner as per the provisions of the notification on Fly ash utilization issued by MoEFCC in Sept’ 1999 and its subsequent amendments.

concerns.title: Air quality exceedances
concerns.explanation: Ambient air quality monitoring shows concentrations exceeding NAAQS limits, indicating potential health risks for nearby residents.
concerns.quote: The Committee noted that the resultant concentrations of all the ambient air quality monitoring parameters are exceeding the standard prescribed limit as per NAAQS, 2009.

concerns.title: Incomplete construction details
concerns.explanation: The proponent failed to present precise construction status and salient features, raising concerns about project readiness and transparency.
concerns.quote: During the meeting, neither the project proponent nor the EIA consultant was able to present the status of construction of 3x600 MW (Unit-1, Unit-5, and Unit-6) and salient features of the proposal under consideration. The documents circulated by the PP does not contain precise information about the proposal under consideration.

concerns.title: Inadequate solar budget
concerns.explanation: The allocated budget for solar rooftop installation is deemed insufficient by the committee, suggesting inadequate renewable energy integration.
concerns.quote: It was also noted that an amount of Rs. 12 Crore has been kept for solar rooftop installation by the PP. Committee found that budget of Rs. 12 Crore for roof top installation is too low.

concerns.title: Stack height uncertainty
concerns.explanation: The proponent lacks clarity on stack height specifications for new units, potentially affecting emission dispersion modeling.
concerns.quote: EAC found that the Proponent had no clarity on stack height that would be installed for 3x600 MW (Unit -1, Unit -5, and Unit -6).

concerns.title: Casual application submission
concerns.explanation: Both proponent and consultant submitted the application casually with misleading information, indicating poor due diligence and transparency.
concerns.quote: EAC observed that project proponent as well as the M/s. GreenCIindia Consulting Private Limited Ghaziabad has submitted the application in a very casual manner. The consultant failed to provide the factual information during the EAC and EAC warned the consultant to avoid submitting such misleading information to the EAC.

4.projectName: Expansion by addition of 1x350 MW Imported Coal based Thermal Power Plant (Phase-ll)

concerns.title: Public hearing exempted
concerns.explanation: Public hearing was exempted by MoEF&CC under notification S.O. 1247(E) dated 18.03.2021 because the project had already been implemented by 63.7%. This denies local residents a formal opportunity to voice concerns and influence project conditions.
concerns.quote: The public hearing (PH) of the project has been exempted by MoEF&CC in line with the notification of No. SO 1247 E dated 18.03.2021.

concerns.title: Existing non-compliance
concerns.explanation: The project had previously not complied with conditions regarding coal transportation (required rail, not road), radioactive analysis of fly ash, annual hydrogeology reviews, CSR audits, green belt width, and coal consumption limits. While some issues were addressed, others remain unresolved or require future compliance.
concerns.quote: Specify condition No- V of EC- II (1x350 MW)- “Coal transportation to plant site shall be undertaken by rail and no road transportation shall be permitted.”

concerns.title: High-ash coal use
concerns.explanation: The coal used has 40% ash content, which is very high. This increases ash generation, requiring more disposal and utilization efforts, and may affect emissions if not properly managed.
concerns.quote: Ash –40(%); Sulphur– 0.5 (%); Moisture (%)-13.30; GCV:3200 Kcal/Kg

concerns.title: Water draw from river
concerns.explanation: The project draws 32,000 m3/day of freshwater from Samal Barrage on Bramhani River during operation. This could strain local water resources, especially in lean seasons.
concerns.quote: Water requirement for the proposed project work (Construction Phase) is estimated as 3669 m3/day and for operation phase 32,000 m3/day of freshwater requirement  will be obtained from the Samal Barrage on Bramhani River.

concerns.title: Forests within vicinity
concerns.explanation: There are forest areas within 10 km of the project site, including Genguta RF, Khalpal RF, and Ganthigarhi PF. While no forest land is directly involved in the project, nearby forests could be affected by emissions, noise, or construction activities.
concerns.quote: Forest 1 Genguta RF 7.5 km WSW 2 Khalpal RF 6.1 km NNE 3 Ganthigarhi PF 5.8 km SW

5.headline: Jindal Power's Tamnar plant must fix 31 violations before expanding

committeeDecision.summary: The EAC deferred the proposal and sought a closure report against the 31 non-compliances reported by the Regional Office and circular slip analysis of the existing ash dyke.
committeeDecision.quote: In view of the foregoing and after the detailed deliberations, the Committee deferred the instant proposal and sought for a closure report against the 31 non-compliances as reported in the certified compliance report dated 25/04/2025 including the non-compliance to the provisions contained under the ash utilization notification 2021 for the existing ash dyke of 4x250 MW. Further, proponent shall also submit the circular slip analysis of the existing ash dyke to ensure the stability of the same as it has been proposed to be used for disposal of ash from 4x600 MW forever. Thereafter, the proposal shall be placed before the EAC for consideration for taking considered view on the amendment request of the project proponent.

6.projectName: Darlipali Super Thermal Power Project, Stage-II

concerns.title: Court case on pollution and health hazards
concerns.explanation: The Orissa Human Rights Commission has a pending case alleging NTPC violates human rights by polluting the environment and causing health hazards due to emissions.
concerns.quote: The complainant alleges that NTPC is violating human rights by polluting the environment in the Sundargarh district, causing health hazards due to emissions from vehicles and chimneys of the power plant.

concerns.title: Project site spans two districts with unclear facility allocation
concerns.explanation: The project site is reported to fall under both Sundergarh and Jharsuguda districts, but no clarity is provided on which facilities will be set up in which district.
concerns.quote: As per the ToR & its amendment accorded by MoEF&CC, project site falls under village Darlipali, Taluk Lephripara, District Sundergarh, Orissa whereas as per the application submitted project site falls in two districts namely Sundergarh and Jharsuguda.

concerns.title: Inconsistent data on baseline collection status
concerns.explanation: The application, brief summary, and presentation contain different statements about the status of baseline data collection, creating confusion about whether it has started or not.
concerns.quote: With respect to baseline data collection, it has been mentioned in the application that data collection is going on from April to June, 2025 and in the brief summary it is stated that data collection is yet to be done.

6.headline: NTPC's Darlipali Super Thermal Power Project demands 930 cubic metres of water an hour near a pending human rights case.

committeeDecision.summary: The Expert Appraisal Committee returned the proposal in its present form, advising the proponent and EIA consultant to revise the ToR amendment application with all relevant information and supporting documents for fresh consideration.
committeeDecision.quote: In view of the foregoing and after detailed deliberations, the EAC recommended to return the proposal in its present form . Project proponent and the EIA consultant has been advised to revise the ToR amendment  application in totality by including all the relevant information with requisite supporting documents and submit the same for fresh consideration by the EAC.

translations.headline: NTPC ର ଡାର୍ଲିପାଲି ସୁପର ଥର୍ମାଲ ପାଉଅର ପ୍ରକଲ୍ପ ଏକ ମାନବ ଅଧିକାର କేସ ପାଖରେ ପ୍ରତି ଘଣ୍ଟା ୯୩୦ କୁବିକ ମିଟର ଜଳ ମାଗିଛି।
translations.dek: ଏହି ସଂଶୋଧନ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ ସମିତି ନିକଟେ ଅସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ ଜାଣकारी ନାହିଁ ଥିବା ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ଫେରିଆସିଛି, ଯାହାର ସମକ୍ଷ ଏକ ଅଦାଲତ କେସ ଉତ୍ସର୍ଗନରୁ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଜୋଖମ ଅବହେଳ କରେ ବୋଲି ଆରୋପ କରେ।
